coverage_model: org-wide via compliance Events API, rolling 90-day window (hard limit)

endpoints.name: List Events (compliance)
endpoints.purpose: PRIMARY org-wide message source. resource=messages returns message create/update/delete events across ALL org spaces regardless of membership; event.data carries the message content (id, roomId, roomType, text, personId, personEmail, created).
endpoints.pagination: cursor via Link header rel=next; from/to time window; max query param
endpoints.incremental_filter: from / to (ISO). HARD LIMIT: search window max 90 days in the past (403 otherwise). resource=messages|memberships|rooms; type=created|updated|deleted
endpoints.deletion_behavior: type=deleted events carry data.id + data.roomId of the removed message (no text). Use to exclude/delete docs.
endpoints.notes: Verified: 1yr/3yr lookback -> 403 'only authorized to search within past 90 days'. deleted + rooms resources exist; updated returned none in test org.

endpoints.name: Get My Own Details
endpoints.purpose: Auth smoke test; returns caller identity and orgId

endpoints.name: List Rooms
endpoints.purpose: List spaces (containers) the authenticated user belongs to
endpoints.pagination: cursor via Link header rel=next; max query param (page size)
endpoints.deletion_behavior: No deletion feed; stale rooms detected by absence in a full crawl

endpoints.name: Get Room Details
endpoints.purpose: Fetch single room detail (enrichment if needed)

endpoints.name: List Messages
endpoints.purpose: List messages within a room (the primary document content)
endpoints.pagination: cursor via Link header rel=next; max query param
endpoints.incremental_filter: before / beforeMessage (time-bound paging; no reliable updated-since or delete feed)
endpoints.deletion_behavior: Deleted messages disappear from listing; no per-message tombstone in list response
endpoints.notes: MEMBERSHIP-SCOPED: returns 404 for rooms the caller is not a member of, even with a compliance token. NOT usable for org-wide content. Org-wide content comes from /events. (Retained for the account-visible fallback only.)

endpoints.name: List Memberships
endpoints.purpose: List members of a room; source of per-document permissions (ACL)
endpoints.pagination: cursor via Link header rel=next; max query param
endpoints.notes: Filter by roomId to get one room's ACL. VERIFIED cross-room: returns HTTP 200 with members even for rooms the caller is NOT in (compliance). This is the org-wide ACL source.

endpoints.name: List People
endpoints.purpose: List/lookup users for identity indexing and permission subject resolution
endpoints.pagination: cursor via Link header rel=next; max query param
endpoints.notes: Can filter by id (batch, ?id=a,b,c), email, or displayName.
